family_naming_note: alibaba-block is the reader-facing scientific family name; cloudphysics is the internal ingestion-path/dataset identifier for the same trace family (see data/processed/cloudphysics/ and trace_name cloudphysics_alibaba_block_head_50k in analysis/wulver_trace_manifest_full.csv). Both resolve to one family; no sixth family or duplicate cells are introduced. campaign_manifest.json cells_by_key already records this per-cell as family="alibaba-block"/internal_family="cloudphysics".
warmup_protocol: none; all policies start at the held-out boundary with a common empty cache and empty bounded-history state
scored_region: inclusive frozen TEST decision_t interval for each manifest cell
learned_policy: frozen HistGradientBoostingRegressor predicts H=16 y_loss; evict minimum prediction
learned_tie_break: stable current resident order, first minimum
